roiCalculator.title: ROI Calculator
roiCalculator.description: Calculate return on investment per unit or project based on costs and sale/rental revenue.

error: Failed to calculate ROI. Please try again.
selectUnitHint: Select a unit to calculate its ROI. Edifice and floor narrow down the unit list.

help.title: About the ROI calculator
help.overview: ROI calculator estimates return on investment for a unit (narrowed by project / edifice / floor) from costs versus sale or rental revenue. It is a calculator on top of existing records, not a stored “ROI document” and not the construction cost-control / budget module.

sections.title: How to run it
items: Select project, optionally edifice and floor, then a unit — calculation runs on pick.
Summary and per-unit breakdown show sale price vs costs vs implied return.
Export PDF for a snapshot of the current computation.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Costs come from unit costs (and related spend). Revenue from sale price or rental assumptions in the calculator.
Changing source records and re-selecting the unit recomputes. Nothing is saved as a budget version here.
Construction budgets, BOQ, and cost commitments live outside this Real Estate menu unless you open those modules separately.

sections.title: Related records
items: Unit, unit costs, sale price fields, optional rental figures.
